label: VWAP (UTC day)
gloss: the volume-weighted average typical price of this timeframe's own bars since the start of the UTC day, as a chart of this timeframe computes it; absent on a rung whose bar is as long as the UTC day

label: VWAP (UTC day) +1σ
gloss: the UTC day VWAP plus 1 volume-weighted standard deviation (line + 1·σ, σ = √(Σhlc3²·v / Σv − VWAP²) over the same bars)

label: VWAP (UTC day) +2σ
